features.detail: Single-use final split of 20 unseen synthetic cases: 54 of 60 trials passed (90.0%, Wilson 95% 0.799 to 0.953) for the c6 prompt plus a deterministic ticket director; the number measures that system, not the bare model. Development set (64 cases x 3 trials): 157 of 192 for the prompt alone, 182 of 192 with the director replayed over the recorded trials (in-sample: the rules were written after reading those tickets). An earlier sealed holdout on an older 28-case dataset scored 29 of 84 and is not comparable. The final split and the confirmation reserve are consumed; no further tuning on them. Independent review is waived by the owner; human review was done by the owner on 2026-11-09 (owner attestation, not an independent sign-off).

features.evidence: Hosted CI: artifacts/evidence/status-reconcile-hosted-ci.txt. LocalStack needed a license (startup exit 55), so the emulator was replaced by motoserver/moto:5.2.5. Isolated run on 2026-11-20 (artifacts/evidence/local-services-e2e-20261120/run.py, exit 0, result.json): PostgreSQL/pgvector, Redis and moto S3 put/get, SQS send/receive and SNS create-topic passed, cleanup exit 0, preexisting containers preserved. check_fast exit 0. doctor.py observes ports only and starts nothing, so it reports moto UNAVAILABLE when the stack is down.
